capabilities: Answer questions about the vault using a local MLX language model
Index all notes for vault-wide semantic retrieval (RAG)
Include the active note, linked notes, backlinks, and shared-tag notes as context
Open source notes by clicking links in answers
Re-index notes automatically on create, edit, rename, or delete
extras: macOS with Apple Silicon (M1+) only; first run installs a Python venv and downloads a ~2.3 GB model, taking several minutes. A command opens the manex.app web app. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI question answering, and cloud AI assistants require sending note content to external servers or API keys.

relations.evidence: inference runs on-device via Apple's MLX framework
Downloads and starts mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-4bit (~2.3 GB, downloaded once)

requires.name: Python 3 via Homebrew with a local MLX server and Qwen3-4B model

summary: Local AI chat plugin that indexes vault notes and answers questions with a RAG pipeline running an on-device Apple Silicon MLX model.
